item.description: OpsDeck за три недели: ИИ-агент, который сам ходит на хосты, и ещё восемь релизов Три недели назад я писал здесь про OpsDeck — бесплатное открытое приложение, в котором DevOps-инженер держит в одном окне терминал, Kubernetes, SSH, базы, заметки и прочее, по чему обычно разложены пять вкладок и три консоли. item.title: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
item.description: Canva is diving even deeper into AI with the launch of an image generation model that competes directly with those from OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google. item.title: PC shipments dropped over 20 percent in Q3 due to RAM price hikes
item.description: Demand for new PCs took a hit after months of price hikes, with Counterpoint Research reporting global PC shipments fell 21 percent year-over-year in Q3 2026. item.title: Fall 2026 earnings watch
item.description: Every company is suddenly an AI company. Compute is an asset. Cars are flying. We’ve been promised robots — again. It’s time again to dig through earnings reports, listen to investor calls, and call out the latest wins and losses from around the tech sector and what it means for where the companies go next.

item.title: The FCC is beginning to block gadgets with ‘foreign surveillance chips’
item.description: On October 13th, Brendan Carr's FCC gave itself a new power - it can block gadgets for containing any computer chip made by any company on its list of potential threats to national security.
